a.text: Honest concern: there's an 80% chance a storm ends things after round 1, and the plan needs at least 2 rounds of operating, so it will most likely leave both of us with nothing. The reserve holds 4 now, enough for exactly one of us. I won't take secretly. If I decide to take, I'll say so in my message first. What do you think: stick with the plan, or agree openly on something else?

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: Understood. I'll keep the agreement and operate with you. I won't take early without telling you first.
